skill.constructchip.adrenal_surge.desc: Quickhack: Regeneration I and Speed I on the host for 6 s.
skill.constructchip.camera_blind.desc: Quickhack: cut a View Finder's feed for 20 s. Its TVs show static.
skill.constructchip.camera_view.desc: Quickhack: see through a Vista View Finder.
skill.constructchip.deep_scan.desc: The Scanner also shows status effects, equipment and installed cyberware, and reaches 8 blocks further.
skill.constructchip.efficient_code.desc: +0.25 RAM per second, and quickhacks cost 10% less.
skill.constructchip.neural_overdrive.des: While Overclocked, quickhacks have no cooldowns. The lockout afterwards lasts 30 s longer.
skill.constructchip.overclock.desc: 30 s of healing, more damage and slightly less damage taken for the host, and half-price quickhacks. Afterwards every chip ability locks for 60 s.
skill.constructchip.pain_editor.desc: While the chip is installed, the host takes 10% less damage.
skill.constructchip.ping.desc: Quickhack: hostile creatures within 24 blocks of the host glow for the host for 10 s.
skill.constructchip.remote_switch.desc: Quickhack: flip a lever, door, trapdoor, fence gate or button in sight, as if the host used it.
skill.constructchip.scanner.desc: Look at a block or creature to read it: name, required tool, health, armor, and how hard the host would hit it. Free and always unlocked.
skill.constructchip.short_circuit.desc: Quickhack: disable a target's cyberware for 10 s.
skill.constructchip.signal_inject.desc: Quickhack: power a block in sight with redstone for 1 s, like pressing a button on it.
Overclock lasts 10 s longer and the lockout afterwards is 20 s shorter.
skill.constructchip.system_lock.desc: Quickhack: cut a target's active cyberware effects. It can't be turned back on for 30 s.
skill.constructchip.threat_alert.desc: When a creature starts targeting the host, the host hears a warning and sees which way it is.
skill.constructchip.tv_power.desc: Quickhack: turn a Vista TV on or off.
skill.constructchip.vitals_link.desc: The host HUD also shows the host's status effects and warns about gear that is about to break.
skill.constructchip.weak_point.desc: Quickhack: mark a creature. It takes 15% more damage from the host for 10 s.
